name: comics-in-code
description: Zen Pencils-style comics drawn entirely in code

scripts.build: for c in uphill ocean butterfly thousand wobbling; do node comics/$c.js; done
scripts.render: for f in up-hill the-great-ocean the-butterfly several-thousand-things wobbling-will; do node lib/render.js out/$f.svg out/$f.png; done
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run render
scripts.qc: python3 qc/score.py out/up-hill.png out/the-great-ocean.png out/the-butterfly.png out/several-thousand-things.png out/wobbling-will.png
